description: Generate text via AI (copy, item descriptions, dialogue). Runs as a job: the call waits up to about two minutes and returns the generated text; if it is not ready by then it returns the generation with status queued/running — poll get_generation with its id. Credits are the publisher's; title_id is an optional label for the report.

title_id.description: Which game this text is for — a label for the report, optional. Credits are always the publisher's, so leaving it out is normal for copy that belongs to no game.

name: generate_text
title: Generate text
